t: You're at the site of St Matthew Friday Street, which stood on Friday Street, just off Cheapside. A church was recorded here from the thirteenth century, until the Great Fire of 1666 destroyed it. It was then rebuilt by the office of Sir Christopher Wren, who was given the task of rebuilding fifty-two City churches. That rebuilt church was demolished in 1885. Sir Edward Clarke, an English merchant who served as Lord Mayor of London in 1696 to 1697, is buried here.
